purpose: Normalize cellular service registration, APN/DNN selection, EPS PDN / 5GS PDU session establishment, IP/link state, DNS and validated internet reachability so SolQvia can localize 'antenna but no data' failures without inference.

dimensions.purpose: Which subscription/SIM is selected for cellular data and whether user/carrier policy permits data.
Basic cellular service state and serving operator before packet session establishment.
Radio access / core registration kept distinct from packet-data session success.

dimensions.privacy_rule: Do not store APN usernames/passwords, subscriber identifiers, or user-specific credentials. APN/DNN names may be stored only when they are public carrier configuration, not user secrets.

dimensions.purpose: EPS PDN connection / 5GS PDU session establishment independent from IP validation.
IP addressing and link properties after a data session is established.
DNS server/link state and actual name-resolution outcome.
Configured Internet capability versus actual validated Internet connectivity.
Actual user-data success under recorded conditions, independent from registration icons or APN configuration.

eps.note: EPS packet-data connectivity is modeled separately from EPS registration.

fivegs.note: 5GS PDU Session attributes such as DNN and PDU Session Type belong to session context; 5GS registration alone does not prove a PDU Session.

android.proves: current service/data registration state and current operator/network-type observations
boundaries: Does not prove APN/DNN session or Internet validation.

android.proves: current data radio technology for the active data subscription
boundaries: Does not by itself prove active validated Internet connectivity.

android.proves: carrier APN configuration used/available for a data connection
boundaries: APN existence does not prove selection, connection, or Internet access.

android.proves: data connection state, APN/APN types, network type, LinkProperties, failure cause, validation state where exposed
boundaries: Network type can change during the data connection and is not a guaranteed instantaneous physical-bearer truth.

android.proves: link addresses, routes, DNS servers, MTU, NAT64/private-DNS metadata
boundaries: Link properties do not prove application traffic success.
NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET means configured for general Internet; VALIDATED is the stronger evidence that Internet connectivity was actually detected.

apple.method: APN UI / carrier settings / MDM APN payload
apple.proves: user- or administrator-visible APN configuration where carrier permits
boundaries: Apple user documentation does not expose EPS/5GS registration or PDU Session internals.

apple.proves: actual mobile-data success/failure under the recorded SIM/eSIM and carrier context
boundaries: Do not infer APN/DNN or internal session cause from runtime success alone.

non_inference_rules: Signal bars do not prove data registration.
4G/5G/5G+ UI does not prove an active or validated data session.
PLMN/service registration does not prove APN/DNN selection.
LTE EPS or 5GS registration does not prove PDN/PDU session establishment.
An APN profile being present does not prove it was selected.
An APN/DNN being selected does not prove the packet session connected.
A connected data session does not prove valid IP routes or DNS.
DNS servers being present does not prove DNS lookup success.
NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET does not prove actual Internet connectivity; VALIDATED is a separate state.
DNS lookup success does not prove all HTTP/HTTPS/application traffic.
Mobile-data success does not prove IMS registration or voice/SMS success.
5G SA registration does not prove VoNR.
APN configuration and eSIM profile configuration are separate layers.
Generic carrier 'data works' evidence does not populate APN, DNN, IP, DNS or exact registration internals unless the source exposes them.
